script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. SUBURBAN PARK - DAY

A group of CHILDREN, ages 7 to 10, scamper around the park, chasing each other and laughing. JASON, the quiet, introverted 7-year-old in the group, watches from a bench, a book in hand.

INT. JASON'S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - LATER

JASON sits on the couch as his mother, LUCY, calls from the kitchen.

LUCY: (shouting) Jason, dinner's ready!

JASON: (shouting back) Coming!

INT. JASON'S SCHOOL - CLASSROOM - NEXT DAY

Miss SMITH writes on the chalkboard while JASON and his classmates sit quietly at their desks.

MISS SMITH: Today we'll be forming groups for our new project. Each group will work on a project, and you'll need to collaborate with your teammates to create something amazing.

The children murmur amongst themselves as they exchange glances. JASON, however, looks anxious.

INT. SCHOOL HALLWAY - DURING RECESS - LATER

JASON sits alone on a bench, looking dejected as the other children play nearby. Suddenly, AMY, a bright, bubbly girl from his class, approaches him.

AMY: (sitting down next to him) Hey, Jason! I saw you sitting here all alone. Do you want to join us?

JASON hesitates, then nods. AMY gathers a group of her friends, and they invite JASON to play a game of tag. He joins in, and for the first time, he laughs and smiles.

INT. JASON'S HOUSE - KITCHEN - NIGHT

Lucy prepares dinner as Jason enters the kitchen, carrying his backpack.

JASON: Mom, I made a new friend at school today. Her name's Amy.

LUCY: (smiling) That's wonderful, Jason! How did that make you feel?

JASON: (grinning) Happy.

INT. SUBURBAN PARK - DAY

Jason, Amy, and their friends play together in the park. They build a sandcastle, have a picnic, and tell stories. As they laugh and enjoy each other's company, Jason looks up at the sky, content.

INT. JASON'S SCHOOL - CLASSROOM - DAY

Miss Smith assigns the groups for the project, and Jason is thrilled to find that he and Amy are in the same group. They brainstorm ideas and work together to create a beautiful diorama of their favorite fairy tale.

INT. JASON'S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jason and his mother sit on the couch as they admire the completed diorama.

LUCY: (proudly) I'm so proud of you, Jason. You've come a long way since the start of the school year.

JASON: (smiling) It's all because of Amy. She's been so kind to me.

INT. SUBURBAN PARK - DAY

The children gather for the school project presentation. Each group shows off their work, and the audience applauds. Jason and Amy's group receives a standing ovation, and they beam with pride.

INT. JASON'S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jason and Amy sit on the couch, watching a movie together. They share a bowl of popcorn and enjoy each other's company.

LUCY: (entering the room) I'm glad you've made such a wonderful friend, Jason.

JASON: (smiling) Me too, Mom. I wouldn't want to miss the adventure with Amy.

FADE OUT.
